newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Security van found empty, driver missing.
newsitem.headline: Security van found empty, driver missing.

text.p: A Belgian man and the 40 million Belgian francs ($1.06 million) being carried in his security van went missing on Monday, the Belga news agency reported.
Police did not know whether the driver had made off with the money or he and the money had been snatched by criminals, the agency said.
The driver vanished in the eastern town of Chaudfontaine while his two partners went into the local casino to pick up Sunday's night's take.
Police found the van in a lane.
